_comment: #760 — per-locale CI floors for the C0-only prompt-PII eval (promptDetectorEval.ts --check). The eval is deterministic (pure regex over committed fixtures), so a drop below a floor is a real change, not noise. de/en/es/fr/it use the official release gates (0.97/0.85). nl cannot meet 0.97 with C0 alone (de-centric address pattern, unpatterned BSN — validation/README.md): its floor is set BELOW today's 88.2% with a deliberate margin so adding honest nl fixtures the current patterns miss does not redden CI — growing the corpus must never be punished; the floor exists to catch pattern regressions, not fixture growth. Raising a floor is welcome; lowering one needs the justification of any ratchet edit.
